title: A Message for Thornfield
description: Elder Moor cuts more timber than it can sell on its own, and Thornfield's mill is the only buyer close enough to matter before the roads freeze. Tharin's last letter to Elder Vorn went unanswered, and he won't send another logger to ask twice - not when there's a stranger in camp worth testing instead. Carry this one yourself. If Vorn signs with someone else before it reaches him, Elder Moor spends the winter with a woodpile nobody wants.

objectives.description: Travel to Thornfield before Elder Vorn looks elsewhere for his timber
Put the letter in Elder Vorn's hands, not a clerk's

notes: Threat: Elder Moor's timber contract with Thornfield lapses if the letter arrives late or not at all. Giver motive: first of four trust tests Tharin runs on a stranger before the Keepers' letter (see tharins_supplies, tharins_wolf_problem, the_letter). Consequence: unwired - a late delivery has no mechanical effect; recorded here for a later pass to gate reputation or a world flag on it.
